purpose: Teach: 学内/人名/右上/左上/つけれ/筐/院内/バッティング

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、大学の学内事件として、捜査を進めております。
lines.en: We're proceeding with the investigation as an internal university matter.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady pace. Even delivery—not rushed, not stalling. Authority without weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。捜査資料の人名、慎重に、扱われていますね。
lines.en: Yes. I understand the personal details in the investigation materials are being handled carefully.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice. Measured pace. Genuine—not performing cooperation, offering it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 監視カメラ、右上から、撮影、捉えていました。
lines.en: The surveillance camera caught the footage from the upper right angle.
lines.style: Factual, direct. Brief pause before each detail—letting information land. Neutral affect. Professional precision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社屋の左上に、防犯カメラ、設置済みです。
lines.en: Yes. We have security cameras already installed in the upper left of the building.
lines.style: Straightforward update. No apology in the tone. Practical—just confirming what's in place. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯ベル、つければ、住民、安心されます。
lines.en: A panic button, once installed, would give residents greater peace of mind.
lines.style: Careful, measured suggestion. Not pushing—offering as consideration. Quiet certainty. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠品の筐体、警察に提出済みです。
lines.en: Yes. We've already submitted the evidence container to the police.
lines.style: Assured, matter-of-fact. Light emphasis on "already"—showing due diligence. No hesitation. Practiced professionalism.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件被害者、院内で、聴取させていただきました。
lines.en: We were able to conduct interviews with the victim at the hospital.
lines.style: Formal, respectful. Slight care in pacing—not rushing past the word "victim." Even tone. Procedural but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域のバッティングセンター、子供たちの居場所、提供しています。
lines.en: Yes. The local batting center is a space we provide where the kids can gather safely.
lines.style: Proud without boasting. Warm undertone—genuinely cares about what this provides. Natural pace. A small smile in the voice.
